title: Whitewashed tombs — simulated justice is dead
english: [[Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, for you are like whitewashed tombs >> Bible:Matthew 23:27]] — fair outside, full of dead bones within. So you appear righteous to people, yet inside are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness. Every pretended justice is a dead justice.
translator_notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Moses’ seat; easy yoke; shutting the kingdom
english: Those who [[sit on Moses’ seat >> Bible:Matthew 23:2]] do all their works [[to be seen by people >> Bible:Matthew 23:5]]. The bodily law’s burden is heavy; Christ’s [[yoke is easy and his burden light >> Bible:Matthew 11:30]] — the Gospel as spiritual law. They [[shut the kingdom of the heavens >> Bible:Matthew 23:13]], neither entering nor letting others in. Glory to Christ. Amen.
